name: CIPROFLOXACIN / HYDROCORTISONE / LIDOCAINE OTICA SUSPENSION 10 ML 1 PIECE
description: Ciprofloxacin and hydrocortisone otic are used to treat external ear infections in adults and children. Ciprofloxacin belongs to a class of medications called quinolone antibiotics. Hydrocortisone belongs to a class of medications called corticosteroids. Jul 15, 2018 If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
